blocks.text: Grant administration requires precision. You manage cycles from initial prospecting to final compliance reports. Google Docs offers a shared environment for these tasks. You do not need a native Mac app to succeed. Chrome or Safari work perfectly for your daily needs. If you work offline, enable the Google Docs Offline extension in Chrome.
Your hands should stay on the keyboard. Use these shortcuts to save time on formatting proposals.

Proposals often reach high page counts. Use headings to build a structure. Press ⌘ + ⌥ + 1 through 6 to apply heading styles. This creates a sidebar outline. You can jump between sections by clicking the outline. This prevents scrolling fatigue during long reviews.

Do not manually adjust font sizes for headers. Use the paragraph styles menu. This ensures consistency across your team. If you copy text from PDFs, use ⌘ + ⇧ + V to strip unwanted formatting. This keeps your document clean and compliant with agency requirements.

Grant work involves many stakeholders. Use the suggesting mode to review edits without changing the original text. You can see who made each change. This creates a clear audit trail for compliance. If you need to discuss a specific paragraph, use ⌘ + ⌥ + M to leave a comment for your team.

Lazur assists you when you feel stuck or tired of repetitive clicks. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ to ask where a button is. Lazur draws a circle around the menu item. Ask Lazur how to perform a task like inserting a table or a watermark. It guides you through the steps one click at a time.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Docs app for Mac?
faq.answer: No. Google Docs is a web-based service accessed through a browser like Chrome or Safari.

faq.question: How do I work on documents without an internet connection?
faq.answer: You must use the Google Chrome browser and install the Google Docs Offline extension.

faq.question: Can I use voice dictation in Google Docs?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate text directly into your document.

faq.question: What is the limit for a single Google Doc?
faq.answer: A single document is limited to 1.02 million characters, regardless of page count.
